name: idle-compact
description: Runs /compact while the session sits idle waiting on background work, right before the prompt cache expires.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes before compacting
idleMinutes.description: Minutes since the last model request before an idle session with background work running is compacted. Keep it under the prompt cache's one-hour lifetime.

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context tokens
minContextTokens.description: Only compact when the context holds at least this many tokens.
